title: Island RNG State Leakage & Generation-Budget Realization

acceptance_criteria.A1_persistent_self_rng: PASS — self._rng initialized once in __init__ at line 1973 of phase2_rule_pool.py; all three call sites (lines 2242, 2847, 2889) replaced with `rng = self._rng`. Verified by grep that no `np.random.default_rng(self.seed)` calls remain in the file.
acceptance_criteria.A2_distinct_island_seeds: PASS — `_derive_island_seed(base_seed, island_id)` helper added (lines 40-58) in phase2_island_scheduler.py using SHA-256 truncation. Applied at line 296 (orphan islands, island_id='orphan_{sym}') and line 374 (cluster islands, island_id=cid). Handles base_seed=None gracefully (returns None).
acceptance_criteria.A3_existing_tests_pass: PASS — 125/125 tests pass in test_phase2_rule_pool.py and test_phase2_island_scheduler.py (PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1). Verified via pytest run in 68.34s.
acceptance_criteria.A4_rng_state_advances_across_run_epoch: PASS — `test_rng_state_advances_across_run_epoch_calls` asserts the bit_generator state changes after each run_epoch() call, proving the persistent RNG advances. Also `test_rng_state_not_reset_between_run_epoch_calls` reinforces the same property.
acceptance_criteria.A5_distinct_seeds_produce_distinct_outpu: PASS — `test_derive_island_seed_distinct_for_distinct_ids` confirms 3 distinct island_ids produce 3 distinct derived seeds. `test_distinct_seeds_produce_distinct_rng_state` confirms two Rule_Pool_Generator instances with different seeds have different bit_generator state. `test_derive_island_seed_deterministic` and `test_derive_island_seed_different_base_differs` provide additional coverage.
acceptance_criteria.A6_evaluator_v5_not_modified: PASS — `git diff main...fix/island-rng-and-budget --name-only | grep -i evaluator` returns no matches. evaluator_v5.ipynb untouched.

out_of_scope_additions: None substantive. The .opencode/CONTEXT.md change is orchestrator bookkeeping (date + state transition) and is not a code/spec concern.
compatibility_check: PASS — `self.seed` attribute is still preserved (line 1972) for any external code that may inspect it. The `_rng` initialization falls back to `_cfg.PHASE2_SEED` when seed is None, preserving prior behavior for the seed=None case. No call sites depend on replaying identical RNG sequences; the persistent-state change is safe.
minor_observations: The test for distinct seeds tests RNG state equality rather than initial population equality directly, but this is functionally equivalent (distinct state -> distinct draws -> distinct populations).
The implementer added a defensive fallback to _cfg.PHASE2_SEED when seed is None, which is sensible but not explicitly required by the spec. Not out-of-scope since it preserves compatibility.
notes: All 6 acceptance criteria met. Implementation is minimal, targeted, and well-tested (8 new tests, all passing). No out-of-scope additions. evaluator_v5.ipynb is untouched per the strict constraint.
